record.question: Which document first defined sustainable development?
record.explanation: Answer B: Brundtland Report. The Brundtland Commission’s 1987 report Our Common Future popularized the first widely used definition of sustainable development. Reference: https://sustainabledevelopment.un.org/content/documents/5987our-common-future.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
